purpose: confirm the incumbent-relative objective after neutral fixed-denominator aggregation of comparative indeterminacy

search_objective.science_preference_for_challenger: negate the incumbent hybrid decision; map the frozen tie interval to zero and linearly scale the remainder to [-1, 1]
search_objective.replacement_rule: replace the incumbent only when combined_preference_for_challenger > 0

comparability_boundary: each challenger is compared only with the incumbent frozen before its round; relative scores from different incumbents are never globally sorted
checkpoint_contract: store the versioned indeterminate policy, incumbent identity, both orientation request hashes, consensus disagreements, fit/science/combined preferences, selected identity, and cumulative incumbent path score in the round checkpoint
pilot_interpretation: development evidence only; do not open test data or claim a benchmark improvement from this run
